turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know, just feeling a bit overwhelmed, I guess. (pauses) Work's been pretty stressful, and it's been hard to get out of bed in the morning. (looks around the room, avoiding eye contact)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Is there anything specific that you'd like to talk about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs) Honestly, I'm not sure. It's just... little things have been bothering me, and I don't know how to shake them off. (pauses, looking down)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Is there anything that you can think of that might make you feel better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) I don't know... I guess if I could just feel more in control, you know? Like, if I could just get all these thoughts out of my head, I'd feel a lot better. (looks up, then quickly looks away again)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Do you think talking to someone might help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (slightly defensive) I don't know... I mean, I'm here, aren't I? But... (trails off) Look, can we just take it one thing at a time? I'm not really sure what's going on, and I don't want to just talk about nothing. (crosses arms)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Of course. We can take it slow and talk about whatever you're comfortable with. Is there anything specific that you'd like to focus on right now?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks down, fidgeting with hands) I don't know... I guess I've just been having some trouble getting out the door in the morning. (pauses, not wanting to elaborate) It's just... I need to do something before I can leave, and it takes a while. (stops talking, not wanting to say more)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Do you think that it might help if you had a plan or a checklist of things to do before you leave?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks up, slightly annoyed) Oh, a plan? Yeah, I've tried that. It doesn't really help. (pauses, trying to explain) It's not like I need to write it down or anything. I just... I have to do it a certain number of times, and if I miss one, I have to start over. (shrugs, not wanting to discuss it further)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I see. Is there anything else that you think might help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (looks down, avoiding eye contact) I don't know... I guess if I could just get rid of these... feelings... that I have before I leave. (pauses, not wanting to elaborate) They're just really annoying, and they make me feel stuck. (stops talking, not wanting to say more)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Do you think talking to someone might help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (slightly frustrated) We're already talking, aren't we? I'm trying to tell you what's going on. (pauses, taking a deep breath) It's just... I don't know how to explain it. It's like... my brain is stuck on this one thing, and I can't turn it off. (looks up, searching for a way to express it) It's like having a song stuck in your head, but it's not a song, it's just... this feeling. (stops talking, feeling overwhelmed)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Do you think talking to someone might help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs) Look, I said I'm trying. I'm here, aren't I? I'm talking to you. (pauses, looking away) I just... I don't know what you can do to help, okay? Can we just move on from this part? (fidgets with hands)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Of course. Is there anything else that you think might help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs, running hands through hair) I don't know... I just feel like I'm stuck in this rut and I don't know how to get out. (pauses, looking down) It's like... every day is the same, and I feel like I'm just going through the motions. (looks up, eyes welling up with tears) I just wish I could feel normal again.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: I understand. Do you think talking to someone might help?
